title: System Extension, House Rule, Scope, Compatibility & Override Authoring

selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MSAS-21 remains terminal completed_verified; MVPS-23 remains terminal completed_verified.

objective: Author bounded system extensions, house rules, scopes, compatibility declarations, precedence/override records and rollback-safe activation definitions over existing owner domains without deleting prior rule history or silently changing unresolved compatibility.
acceptance: disable/rollback restores prior effective-rule resolution without deleting history
boundaries: MRCS-01/03/04/05/08/11/12/13/14 remain the authoring foundations consumed by this tranche.
House rules and system extensions remain definition/configuration records; owning runtime domains retain execution and live-state mutation authority.
Scope, applicability, compatibility and precedence are explicit; unknown compatibility or target scope remains unresolved rather than inferred.
Conflicting override candidates remain visible and diagnosable rather than silently picking a winner.
Disable/rollback changes effective resolution while preserving immutable prior definition/version/history evidence; it does not delete source history.
MRCS-17+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
MSAS and MVPS remain terminal completed_verified.
next_action: On an MRCS-specific owner Continue, fresh-read the MRCS-16 dependency closure and mrcs lane-state ref, then start and execute the bounded tranche under OPS3-11 milestone-only execution.
